item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 17/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China tomorrow. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong on Saturday morning. It will become cold appreciably over the region. The associated intense winter monsoon will bring persistently cold weather during the weekend to midweek next week. Besides, upper-air disturbances will bring unsettled weather to southern China from Saturday to early next week. With the upper-air disturbances departing, the weather will improve over the region in the latter part of next week.
